meta.title: Kernel modules
meta.description: Browse Linux kernel modules and .ko files; load and unload modules at runtime.

runtime.description: Entries visible only in sysfs may be built into the kernel. Their presence does not establish unload support.
runtime.unavailable: Browsing is available. Operations require Android ARM64 root and readable /proc/modules.
runtime.unloadConfirm: Unload {name}? Removing kernel code can freeze or restart the device.
runtime.unloadBlocked: Unavailable while the module is in use, transitioning, or lacks an unloadable reference state.
runtime.protected: Protected root module. Unloading is blocked by this app.
runtime.holdersUnavailable: Holder state is unavailable. Unloading is blocked until it can be read.

files.description: Inspect uncompressed .ko files on this device without loading them.
files.empty: No .ko files found. You can enter a device file path above.
files.truncated: Scan limit reached. Browse a specific file to inspect it.
files.loadConfirm: Load {name}? Kernel code can freeze or restart the device. Dependencies must already be loaded.
files.unknown: Kernel release could not be compared.
files.compatibility: Release matching is informational. With symbol CRCs the kernel may accept a different release prefix; ABI, symbols, signature and policy checks remain authoritative.
files.metadataReplaced: Some metadata bytes are not valid UTF-8. Replacement characters are shown; the file digest still covers the original bytes.
files.formatUnsupported: Loading requires a little-endian ARM64 ELF64 module.
files.vermagicRequired: Loading requires one nonempty vermagic entry.
files.alreadyLoaded: A module with this name is already visible in the kernel.
files.nameTooLong: ARM64 module names must fit in 55 bytes.

operation.currentBoot: Manual operations affect this boot. System startup rules are not changed.

errors.state_unavailable: Kernel state could not be read.
errors.unsupported_environment: Operations require an Android ARM64 root process.
errors.file_changed: The file changed. Inspect it again.
errors.modules_disabled: The kernel has disabled module loading and unloading.
errors.module_busy: The module is in use, transitioning or not unloadable.
errors.operation_timeout: Operation timed out; outcome unknown. Refresh before proceeding.
errors.operation_unknown: The worker stopped without a reliable result. Outcome unknown; refresh before proceeding.
errors.module_protected: This root module is protected from unloading.
